THE
OG.

Naina Garments started in Villupuram with one rule — never drop a piece we wouldn't wear ourselves. From embossed full sleeves to Korean street shirts, every article is picked for fabric first, hype second.

Premium streetwear, trending articles on men's garments, and a fit that actually feels like it was made for you. Bigger fit. Better feel. Bolder you.
